title: Ka bɔ kɔnɔko fili la
description: Nin baro in bɛ ka se AI ka hakilijagabɔ dan ma, i n’a fɔ tablo finman bɛ fa. An bɛ se ka hakilijagabɔ-yɔrɔ (min bɛ wele ko contexte size) bonya walasa a hakili ka to ka caya, nka a bɛ se ka baara kɛ ni i ka ɔridinatɛri hakilijagabɔlan caman ye. An bɛ se fana ka donnakow tigɛ, o kɔrɔ ye ko a bɛna ɲinɛ baro tariku dɔw kɔ walasa ka yɔrɔ di cikan kuraw ma.
increaseContextSizeDescription: Yala aw b’a fɛ ka dɔ fara contexte hakɛ kan wa?
increaseContextSize: Ka dɔ fara Contexte hakɛ kan
lastRequestOverflowed: Delili laban ye context window (kɔnɔnafili) fa.
contextOverflowDetail: Nin ɲinini in mago tun bɛ {{request}} tokenw na, nka modɛli ka kɔnɔko finɛtiri bɛ {{context}} dɔrɔn de minɛ.
contextOverflowGeneric: Delili bɛ tɛmɛ kɔnɔko hakɛ kan min bɛ sɔrɔ.
emptyReply: Modeli banna k'a sɔrɔ a ma jaabi segin. Aw bɛ a ɲini ka fɛnw labɛn kokura, walima ka furakɛlikɛlaw ka sigicogo lajɛ.

engine.unknown: Modeli motɛri ye fili dɔ fɔ min tun ma labɛn.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_FAILED: Modeli ma se ka doni ta.
engine.MODEL_ARCH_NOT_SUPPORTED: Nin modɛli in jɔcogo tɛ dɛmɛ ni sisan motɛri ye. Ni i ye motɛri kura ye ka bɔ Settings kɔnɔ, o bɛ se ka dɛmɛ dɔ fara a kan.
engine.MODEL_LOAD_TIMED_OUT: Modeli ye waati jan ta ka doni ta, a jɔra. A ka c’a la, modɛli fitinin walima contexte hakɛ fitinin bɛ dɛmɛ.
engine.MISSING_SHARED_LIBRARY: Motɛri mago bɛ gafemarayɔrɔ min na, o tɛ yen, o la a tɛ se ka daminɛ.
engine.GPU_DRIVER_TOO_OLD: I ka GPU bolifɛntigi kɔrɔla kojugu nin motɛri in na. Sofɛrɛ kurayali, walima ka wuli ka taa CPU motɛri la Settings kɔnɔ, o bɛna o ɲɛnabɔ.
engine.OUT_OF_MEMORY: Hakilila bɛrɛ tɛ yen walasa ka nin modɛli in boli. A ka c’a la, modɛli fitinin walima contexte hakɛ fitinin bɛ dɛmɛ.
engine.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Modeli ka sigicogo dɔ tɛ baara kɛ.
engine.IO_ERROR: Filen dɔ ma se ka kalan walima ka sɛbɛn ka sɔrɔ ka modɛli daminɛ.
engine.INTERNAL_ERROR: Fɛn dɔ ma ɲɛ Novera kɔnɔ ka modeli daminɛ.
engine.ENGINE_UNREACHABLE: llama.cpp motɛri bɛ baara la, nka Novera tɛ se ka don a la ɔridinatɛri in kan (127.0.0.1). VPN, proxy walima lakana porogaramu dɔ bɛ se ka sigida ɲɔgɔndanw bali.
engine.ENGINE_STOPPED: llama.cpp motɛri jɔra a ma deli ka kɛ. Cikan cilen seginni bɛ a daminɛ kokura; ni a tora ka jɔ, lakana porogaramu walima GPU bolifɛn bɛ se ka kɛ o sababu ye.
engine.UNSUPPORTED_CPU: Sigida modɛliw tɛ dɛmɛ sɔrɔ ɔridinatɛri in ka baarakɛminɛn kan. Novera ka sigida motɛri dilannen don Apple Silicon Macs (M1 walima a kura) kama, o la a tɛ se ka daminɛ Intel Mac kan. Sankaba ni ladamu dilanbagaw bɛ baara kɛ hali bi.
